title: Classified signals lab picks up a signal from the implant
place_text: Southwest Research Institute, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: And it turns off. And the lab guys say, "We've got a signal, but we can't tell you anything about it because the lab's classified."

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer who says he has met alien beings, says that in the mid-1990s a small object he calls an implant, taken from his body, was examined at the Southwest Research Institute, a research lab in San Antonio, Texas. He says the lab staff told him they detected a signal coming from it, which then turned off, but that they could tell him nothing more because the lab was classified. If true, it would suggest the object was a working device.
